verdict.rationale: Oneleet lists SOC 2 among its supported frameworks and automatically adds controls when you enable a framework. It also ships customizable policy templates with a draft-and-publish workflow, and its pentest feeds straight into the audit. Cloud, GitHub and Workspace integrations, plus Fieldwork's AI agents, collect evidence, which covers much of a SOC 2 program on one platform. missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II audit support, documentation that the controls map to the Trust Services Criteria, a documented evidence-request workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
